definitions.explanation: A cave formed in limestone by the dissolving action of water, typically featuring stalactites and stalagmites. Many such caves in Japan are popular tourist attractions.

examples.japanese: {鍾乳洞|しょうにゅうどう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{探検|たんけん}→探検：17461_tanken⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
{鍾乳洞|しょうにゅうどう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{中|なか}→中：00654_naka⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{夏|なつ}→夏：02236_natsu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{涼|すず}しい→涼しい：00674_suzushii⟧。
examples.english: It's cool inside the limestone cave even in summer.

examples.japanese: {何万年|なんまんねん}⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦かけて→かける：00854_kakeru⟧⟦{形成|けいせい}→形成：12541_keisei⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧{鍾乳洞|しょうにゅうどう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{美|うつく}しさ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{感動|かんどう}した→感動する：21603_kandousuru⟧。
examples.english: I was moved by the beauty of the limestone cave, formed over tens of thousands of years.

notes:
FORMS:
{鍾乳|しょうにゅう} (stalactite) + {洞|どう} (cave). The character {鍾|しょう} is uncommon outside this word.

FAMOUS EXAMPLES IN JAPAN:
- {秋芳洞|あきよしどう}: Akiyoshi-do ({山口県|やまぐちけん})
- {龍泉洞|りゅうせんどう}: Ryūsen-do ({岩手県|いわてけん})
- {龍河洞|りゅうがどう}: Ryūga-do ({高知県|こうちけん})

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{鍾乳石|しょうにゅうせき}→鍾乳石：24538_shounyuuseki⟧: stalactite (hangs from ceiling)
- {石筍|せきじゅん}: stalagmite (grows from floor)
- ⟦{洞窟|どうくつ}→洞窟：05038_doukutsu⟧: cave (general term)

CULTURAL NOTE:
{鍾乳洞|しょうにゅうどう} are popular tourist destinations in Japan, especially in summer because the cave interior stays cool year-round.
